name: Sukumo (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Sukumo city emblem in white: a stylised loop with crossed ends, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Sukumo, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 January 1961.

features.role: Sukumo city emblem — a stylised loop with crossed ends, like a stylised character
